# Avrupa Araştırmaları Enstitüsü - Marmara Üniversitesi

> > Leading Turkish academic institute dedicated to European studies, EU-Turkey relations, and European integration research at Marmara University, Istanbul.

The Institute of European Studies at Marmara University conducts interdisciplinary research on the European Union, publishes the peer-reviewed Marmara Journal of European Studies (MJES), and offers graduate programs in EU Law and European Studies. As a Jean Monnet Center of Excellence, it serves as a bridge between Turkey and Europe in academic research and policy analysis.

## Key Topics

- European Union (EU)
- Turkey-EU Relations
- European Integration
- MJES (Marmara Journal of European Studies)
- EU Law
- Jean Monnet Center of Excellence
- Syrian Refugees and Migration
- Turkey-Germany Relations
- Academic Publishing and Peer Review
- European Studies Research
- Higher Education Cooperation
- EU Foreign Policy
- Ankara Agreement
- ULAKBIM and EBSCO Indexing

## Marmara Journal of European Studies (MJES)

- [Hakkında](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/mjes-maad/hakkinda): About MJES journal: publication principles, peer review, and indexing

- [MJES Vol.28 No.2](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol28-no2): MJES Vol.28 No.2 on EU foreign policy, climate, and trade
- [MJES Vol.27 No.1](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol27-no1): MJES Vol.27 No.1 on European integration and Turkey-EU relations
- [MJES Vol.25 No.2](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol25-no2): MJES journal Vol.25 No.2 on EU citizenship, borders, and sovereign debt
- [MJES Vol.14 No.1](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol14-no1): MJES Vol.14 No.1 on OSCE, Helsinki Final Act, and Turkey-EU relations
- [MJES Vol.7 No.1-2](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol7-no1-2): MJES Vol.7 on Black Sea cooperation, Euro transition, and human rights
- [MJES Vol.1 No.1-2](https://avrupa.marmara.edu.tr/avrupa-arastirmalari-enstitusu/yayinlar/marmara-avrupa-arastirmalari-dergisi-mjes/mjes-vol1-no1-2): MJES inaugural issue Vol.1 on Turkey-EU relations and Ankara Agreement
